description: Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions: natural hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Open Data Armenia, an open data portal (CKAN) run by a civil-society initiative, published or maintained by Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions. Coverage: Scientific Network for the Caucasus Mountain Regions. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about natural hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Armenia: Landslides; Armenia: Avalanche Hazard Level; Armenia: Seismic Zonation; Armenia: Probabilistic Seismic Hazard Assessment. Formats seen: XML, ZIP, JPEG, PDF, PNG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opendata-am.
